annotations.title: Local fees and transport tax limits

description: Use for local fees and their upper limits: tourist (local) fee and spa fee for a stay (per night from 2027), dog fee, market fee, advertising fee, tax on trucks, tractor units, trailers and buses, agricultural and forest tax per hectare. The municipality sets its own rate up to the limit; give the limit as a maximum. Upper limits of Polish local fees set yearly by the Minister of Finance: tourist (local) fee and spa fee (per day until 2026, per night from 1 January 2027: landscape resort, spa protection area, spa), dog fee per year, market fee per day, advertising fee, tax on trucks, tractor units, trailers and buses per year, and agricultural and forest tax per hectare from GUS rye and wood prices. Optional nights, persons and resort_type give the maximum tourist or spa fee for a stay (stays over 29 nights are exempt). Includes finwire_resort_fee_family_week (7 nights, 2 adults and 2 children). Municipalities set their own rates up to these limits.

nights.description: Nights of the stay for the tourist or spa fee.

resort_type.description: landscape = tourist fee in a landscape resort, spa_protection_area = tourist fee in a spa protection area, spa = spa fee. Default landscape.
